title: Generic groundwater application orchestration — FMR participant registry
goal: Provide a production handle-based registry over admitted fmr_groundwater_swap_participant_t so a later generic application service can address multiple real SWAP participants without exposing kernel internals, committed-state storage, backend internals or topology-specific bridges.
design: registry stores no copy of committed SWAP state
each active slot holds an opaque monotonically unique handle plus tile identity and Fortran pointers to production-owned FMR objects
all capture/trial/discard/preflight/commit operations delegate to fmr_groundwater_swap_participant_t
stale/released handles fail closed and cannot target a reused slot
tile ids are unique among active registrations
release is forbidden while a candidate is live
registry itself owns no predictor/corrector algorithm, ledger, MODFLOW, XMI or timestep lifecycle
first Stage-B envelope binds the concrete admitted fmr_groundwater_head_forcing_materializer_t
exclusions: C ABI/global singleton before application context ownership is fixed
next_permitted_action: Open draft PR, obtain owner and F-VQ122 evidence, repair only scoped failures, then admit/close Stage B. Only after Stage B closes may F-GC49C bind a generic live application context/service.
implemented: fixed-capacity production registry sized by application context
non-recycling used slots and stale-handle rejection
external ownership pointers for backend, parameters, committed state and forcing materializer
immutable copied binding metadata for column, template, numerical configuration and datum
delegation to admitted fmr_groundwater_swap_participant_t for capture/trial/discard/preflight/commit
release fails closed while candidate is live
reinitialize fails while registrations remain active
owner_qualification: two real FMR handles over independent committed lineages
candidate isolation and nonmutating trial behavior

independent_qualification.claim: Source/ownership verifier proves committed state is referenced not copied, participant lifecycle is delegated, handles are nonrecycling/monotonic, and MODFLOW/ledger/solver ownership does not leak into registry.

admission_criteria: exact-head F-GC49B owner real-FMR qualification green
canonical delta reconciled without dependency conflict
production delta limited to participant registry
